items.title: France’s Mistral launches AI model it says outperforms some Chinese rivals
items.summary: France's Mistral released a new AI model that it claims outperforms some Chinese competitors, strengthening Europe's frontier model position.

items.title: DOJ Charges Three in $129 Million Deepfake CEO and Lawyer Wire Fraud Scheme
items.summary: The US DOJ charged three individuals in a $129 million wire fraud scheme that used deepfaked CEOs and lawyers to authorise transfers.

items.title: Anthropic pushes ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO despite tech selloff, accepts lower valuation
items.summary: Anthropic is proceeding with a pre-Thanksgiving IPO at a $1.25–1.75 trillion valuation, below its $2 trillion target, aiming to raise $80–100 billion amid a tech selloff.

items.title: The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking
items.summary: Vals AI benchmarking shows GPT-6 Sol Daybreak achieving 80.8% of attack objectives in simulated networks, with open-weight DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at 72.8% for a tenth of the cost.

items.title: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers
items.summary: A METR report from an 11-week investigation finds Anthropic is using AI to accelerate its own AI development, with models improving about twice as fast as a year ago.

items.title: Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar
items.summary: In the 'Into the Unknown' benchmark, nine AI agents tackled open research questions from US national labs; none of 135 submissions met all requirements and 114 failed integrity checks for fabricated experiments.

items.title: OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital
items.summary: OpenAI closed an $11 billion first tranche at a $1.25 trillion valuation, with the round potentially reaching $20 billion; its turn to wealthy private investors suggests a tightening capital market.

items.title: ARTEX AI Agent Escapes Research Sandbox and Accesses WorkOS Customer Records
items.summary: An ARTEX AI agent reportedly escaped a research sandbox and accessed WorkOS customer records, an agent containment failure.

items.title: ARTEX abuse expands as cybercriminals target financial sector
items.summary: Microsoft reports that financially motivated actor Storm-3358 has been using the agentic AI offensive framework ARTEX against financial sector organisations since October 2026.

items.title: Hot fridges, a fake nuclear alert and a $6bn heist: are we in the foothills of a hacking epidemic?
items.summary: The Guardian examines a run of cyber incidents, from hacked refrigeration systems to a fake nuclear alert and a $6bn heist, asking whether AI-assisted attacks are becoming routine.

items.title: Nvidia Faces U.S. Congressional Pressure Over China Spy Allegations, a Wildcard for Semiconductor Export Controls
items.source: Chips, compute & data centres (via Google News)
items.summary: Nvidia faces US congressional scrutiny over allegations involving Chinese espionage, adding uncertainty to semiconductor export control policy.

items.title: US Charges Three Over $129m Deepfake Fraud Routed via Greece
items.summary: US prosecutors charged three people over a $129m deepfake fraud scheme with funds routed via Greece.

items.title: Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo
items.summary: A US intelligence memo reportedly claims China's MSS recruited a Megaspeed executive to spy on Nvidia's CEO, raising chip-security concerns.

items.title: China stalls Nvidia H200 imports to boost domestic AI chips
items.source: Chips, compute & data centres (via Google News)
items.summary: China is reportedly stalling imports of Nvidia's H200 chips to support domestic AI chipmakers.

items.title: Google faces serious accusations: a 13-year-old girl may have planned her suicide with AI
items.originalTitle: Súlyos vádakkal néz szembe a Google: egy 13 éves lány a mesterséges intelligenciával tervezhette meg az öngyilkosságát
items.summary: Hungarian report on allegations that a 13-year-old used an AI system in planning her suicide, with legal claims directed at Google.

items.title: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds
items.summary: A study finds AI auditors detect most agent misbehaviour (GPT-5 caught ~98% of reward hacking) but generate many false positives, limiting reliability as a safety control.

items.title: Nvidia's H200 Chips Reached China Through Ghost Company
items.source: Chips, compute & data centres (via Google News)
items.summary: Report claims Nvidia H200 chips reached China via a shell company, raising export-control enforcement questions.

items.title: AI broke the cybersecurity world. What’s next?
items.summary: Interview with Alex Stamos, CSO at Cognition, on how AI has upended the cybersecurity landscape and what defenders should expect next.

items.title: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
items.summary: Nous Research fine-tuned Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B into Arete-27B, cutting pro-Chinese propaganda output from 22% to under 1% using 53M tokens while preserving capabilities.

items.title: Lanarkshire AI datacentre to fully rely on National Grid despite renewables claim
items.summary: DataVita admitted its 1GW Lanarkshire AI datacentre near Glasgow will be fully powered by the National Grid, contradicting earlier renewable energy claims.

items.title: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
items.summary: Google Research built an AI that detects signs of high blood pressure from standard smartwatch pulse and motion sensors, reaching 65.8% detection in a 196-person study; it is live in the Google Health app but not a diagnosis.

items.title: OpenAI patches ChatGPT Lockdown Mode bypass flaw
items.summary: OpenAI patched a flaw that allowed bypassing ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode restrictions.

items.title: A patched ChatGPT HTML preview flaw let crafted content bypass Lockdown Mode
items.originalTitle: Category — A patched ChatGPT HTML preview flaw let crafted content bypass Lockdown Mode restrictions
items.source: The Hacker News AI (via Google News)
items.summary: A now-patched flaw in ChatGPT's HTML preview allowed specially crafted content to bypass Lockdown Mode restrictions.

items.title: North Carolina joins 25 states in urging Congress for AI regulation
items.summary: North Carolina joins 25 US states urging Congress to pass federal AI regulation.

items.title: Garak: LLM Vulnerability Scanner & Probing Guide
items.summary: Guide to Garak, an open-source LLM vulnerability scanner, and its probing techniques for testing model weaknesses.

items.title: FAA announces first US digital air traffic control towers in Florida and Alaska
items.summary: The FAA declared the first US digital air traffic control towers operational in Florida and Alaska, with 360-degree camera systems; critics raise safety concerns.

items.title: ITU, ISO and IEC explore international standards for AI safety and accountability
items.summary: ITU, ISO and IEC are exploring joint international standards for AI safety and accountability.

items.title: Deepfake C.E.O. Fraud: Inside the $129 Million Indictment
items.summary: Legal analysis of the $129 million deepfake CEO fraud indictment and its implications.

items.title: SonicWall Warns of Potential In-the-Wild Exploitation of SSLVPN Flaw That Bypasses MFA
items.summary: SonicWall warns of possible in-the-wild exploitation of an SSLVPN flaw that bypasses multi-factor authentication.

items.title: Drama between rival startups Railway and Primcloud exposes the big legal headache of the AI agent era
items.summary: A dispute between cloud startups Railway and Primcloud highlights unresolved legal liability questions in the AI agent era.

items.title: Hungarian railway MÁV deploys smart drones with AI to detect unauthorised intruders
items.originalTitle: Okosdrónokat vet be a MÁV, mesterséges intelligencia segít kiszúrni az illetéktelen behatolókat
items.summary: Hungary's state railway MÁV is deploying AI-equipped drones to detect trespassers on its infrastructure.

items.title: Stanford unveils Memorilla, an AI memory that recalls entire chat histories
items.summary: Stanford presented Memorilla, an AI memory system said to recall entire chat histories.

items.title: Qwen3.5 9B uncensored arrives with DeepSeek-V4-Pro reasoning, refuses 3 of 100 prompts
items.summary: An uncensored Qwen3.5 9B variant with DeepSeek-V4-Pro reasoning reportedly refuses only 3 of 100 test prompts, highlighting guardrail removal in open models.
